blocks.text: Leviticus 15 contains 33 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying, It concludes with: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus distinguishes ritual impurity from moral offenses rather than treating every unclean condition as personal sin.
